title: Govt Job Titles — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A job title as registered with the government, which can differ from the internal job title. Used on employees' sponsor records and for sponsor job-title quotas.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: GovtJobCategory
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Govt Job Category master data.
fields.html: What it is. The government job category.

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.
